issues.detail: Managed metadata exceeds the 67108864 byte representation budget

limitations: Member decoding exceeded capacity after the type inventory was admitted; fields, methods, member references, call edges, field accesses, exported types and user strings are not examined to completion. Empty member collections do not establish absence.
Use the returned TypeDef full_name values with type_names (CLI --type) to inspect a smaller selection; a single selected type can still exceed capacity.
Metadata tokens are build-local coordinates and require the reported artifact SHA-256 and MVID. Type names and list ranges retain their original metadata and nesting uncertainty.
